description: Defines the Ocean color palette and a custom Material 3 theme for a Flutter app, encapsulated in OceanColors and OceanTheme classes.

classes.name: OceanColors
classes.description: A class containing static color constants representing the Ocean theme palette, including primary, secondary, error, background, surface, and text colors.

classes.name: OceanTheme
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate ThemeData objects with customized Material 3 styling for light theme, utilizing OceanColors palette.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData configured with Ocean color palette, Material 3, rounded corners, subtle elevation, and other stylistic choices consistent with the Ocean theme.
